body.usage: Clean, highly readable text for booking forms and tracking dashboards.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tighter leading-none

rules: Use #5B21B6 (Deep Violet) for primary CTAs, active stepper states, and driver map pins.
The app background must be Slate-50 (#F8FAFC) to allow stark white (#FFFFFF) cards to pop.
Never use pure black text. Use Slate-900 (#0F172A) for max contrast without harshness.
Status elements (Live tracking, Driver Assigned) must use vibrant Emerald (#10B981).

visual_enhancers.cards: Neumorphic Tactile: White cards (bg-white) with a crisp 1px border (border-slate-200) and soft ambient shadow (shadow-sm). Interactive cards (van size selection) must lift on hover (-translate-y-1) and gain shadow-md.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For the mobile sticky-bottom price summary or sticky header nav: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t/border-b border-slate-200.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Rounded (rounded-lg). Primary buttons must use the brand violet. Add a subtle transition-all duration-200. No pill shapes; keep it slightly structured to match the van/logistics theme.

components.custom_booking_stepper: Implement a horizontal progress tracker at the top of the booking flow. Show completed steps, current step, and upcoming. Use the brand primary color for completed/active.
components.persistent_summary: A sticky summary panel on desktop (right side) or sticky bottom bar on mobile showing 'Total Quote: £X' that updates dynamically.
components.map_tracking: A large, immersive map container (rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-inner) showing a custom pin for the driver's live location.

grids_and_layouts.marketing_home: Asymmetrical Bento grid for features. Avoid the 'center-everything' disease. Hero section: 12-column grid, content spanning 7 columns left, overlapping image grid on the right.
grids_and_layouts.booking_flow: Single-column layout (max-w-2xl mx-auto). Follow Progressive Disclosure—only show the inputs required for the current step.
grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: High-density grid (gap-4). Admin tables should stretch to fill containers. Strip away unnecessary card borders in the table to maximize data visibility.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy for marketing (p-12, p-16, gap-12). Dense Spacing for Admin/Dispatch (p-4, p-6, gap-4).

motion.booking_transitions: Use framer-motion for step transitions. Slide left-to-right (x: 20 -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1) for a frictionless feel.
motion.live_tracking_pulse: The driver's location pin on the map must have an outer ring with an infinite scale and fade animation (animate-ping) to indicate live status.
motion.hover_states: All cards and buttons require micro-animations (e.g., hover:border-violet-300 transition-colors).

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Ensure white text on brand violet has maximum readability.
accessibility.focus: All form inputs (postcode search, dates) must use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500 focus:border-transparent.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, specifically the multi-step form inputs and 'Next/Confirm' buttons, MUST include `data-testid` attributes.

image_urls.description: White commercial van driving. Use for Hero Section background or tracking visualization.
Happy couple moving boxes. Perfect for the 'Why Choose Us' or trust-building section.
Clean modern living room with boxes. Use for 'Residential Moves' service card.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use generic center-aligned layouts. Left-align typography to preserve reading flow, especially in the multi-step booking form.
Do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the CSS file.
Ensure the Quote Engine immediately calculates price based on selected van size and fake distance before user proceeds to booking details.
The Multi-step booking flow MUST use a structured wizard (e.g., 1. Route -> 2. Van Size & Date -> 3. Details -> 4. Review & Book).
Never use completely transparent backgrounds over imagery or maps (e.g., the tracking screen overlay). Always use backdrop-blur or solid fill.
Admin/Dispatch dashboard should feel like a 'Command Center'. High density, data-first. Remove heavy card styles for data tables.
Use lucide-react for all iconography. Avoid emojis.
Use sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Booking Confirmed', 'Driver Assigned').
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable on marketing pages. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all without duration/property) that breaks transforms. Use specific utilities like transition-colors or transition-transform.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
